Hevy | Lead/Senior React Native Engineer & Lead/Senior Backend Engineer | Barcelona, Spain | Hybrid | Relocation

Hevy is a multiplatform weight lifting tracker that lets athletes log their workouts, track progress and be part of a community of gym athletes. We are a bootstrapped fitness and technology company operating out of Barcelona, Spain.

Relocation to Spain: full relocation package, work permit + residence permit for spouse, hybrid (2-3 days in office/week), competitive salary + performance bonus. https://www.hevyapp.com/careers/
